Extended skater and goalie game stats per team (2023/24 on)

Source: R/shl.R
shl_player_box.Rd

Wraps GET https://www.shl.se/api/gameday/player-stats/{game_uuid} of the SHL site API (www.shl.se). Unofficial use of a public source; seasons are END years (2026 = 2025/26) and are mapped to the site's ssgt uuids through /statistics-v2/layout-info.

Usage

shl_player_box(game_uuid, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

game_uuid

Game uuid (gameInfo[].uuid from /sports-v2/game-schedule). gameday/* has data from 2023/24 on; older games answer 200 with an empty body.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE); FALSE returns the raw decoded JSON as a list.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (the raw JSON list when return_parsed = FALSE) with the following columns:

col_nametypedescription
team_sidecharacterSide of the game: home or away.
position_groupcharacterskater or goalie (goalies come from the body's gkStats rows).
player_idintegerisa (StatNet) player id, integer. Play-by-play sends it as a string, every other route as an integer; it is cast here so the frames join.
team_idcharacterTeam code (e.g. FHC) in gameday and standings payloads; not the team uuid.
periodintegerPeriod: 0 = the whole game, 1-3 the periods, 4 and up overtime.
full_namecharacterGiven name and surname.
first_namecharacterGiven (first) name of the player.
last_namecharacterSurname (family name) of the player.
nrintegerJersey (shirt) number of the player.
poscharacterPosition code in this game (e.g. CE, LW, RW, D, GK).
lineintegerLine (unit) number the player was listed on.
gnumericNumber of goals scored.
anumericNumber of assists credited.
ppgnumericPower-play goals.
swnumericNumber of shots that missed the net.
pimnumericPenalty minutes.
sognumericNumber of shots on goal.
ppsognumericPower-play shots on goal.
plus_minusnumericPlus/minus in the game.
toicharacterTime on ice (mm:ss). Clock/duration as an mm:ss string.
hitsnumericBody checks delivered.
fownumericNumber of face-offs won.
folnumericFace-offs lost.
fo_percnumericFace-off win %.
ganumericNumber of goals conceded (goals against).
soganumericShots on goal against.
spganumericUnverified goalie column (box score).
svsnumericNumber of saves made by the goalie.
svs_percnumericSave percentage of the game as a FRACTION 0-1 (e.g. '0.9655...'); integer 0 for a goalie without shots. Numeric, but sent as a string in some rows and as a number in others.
tpnumericPoints (goals + assists).
shgnumericShorthanded goals.
nepnumericOn ice for goals against (count).
popnumericOn ice for goals for (count).
fo_totnumericFace-offs taken.
num_pennumericNumber of penalties.
msnumericMissed shots (wide + blocked).
bk_snumericNumber of blocked shots.

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the host answered 404, an empty body (gameday routes before 2023/24), a table with no rows, or the season and game type are not in layout-info. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx answer or a dead connection after retries, a non-JSON or error-envelope 200, a stats-info page that reaches count or falls short of its totalCount, or a body for another game, team, athlete or ssgt than the one asked for. fastRhockey_bad_request: a 400 / 422, a season that is not a year, or an argument outside its choices.
